title: Proposal: mandatory evaluation gates for LLM releases
subtitle: Why we should block releases that fail automated evaluation, and how to roll it out by Q1
author: AI Engineering

blocks.title: Recommendation
blocks.text: Make automated evaluation a **required release gate** for every LLM feature from January. The judge now agrees with expert raters (κ = 0.82) and would have caught all three Q3 regressions.

Until this year, LLM quality was measured by sampling about 2% of conversations for manual review. Findings arrived two weeks after a release, which meant regressions were discovered by customers first. Since April we have run an LLM-as-judge pipeline that scores most production conversations daily against a shared rubric.
The judge is now accurate enough to act on. Agreement with expert human raters has reached **0.82 Cohen's κ** across six channels, above the 0.75 bar we set for decision use.
Billing resolution quality trails every other channel by at least 13 points. Root-cause review traced most failures to stale policy documents in the retrieval corpus rather than to the model itself.

blocks.caption: Figure 1. Mean judge resolution score by channel, Jul–Sep 2026 (illustrative).

blocks.text: Retrieval and prompt changes shipped since April cut unsupported claims by two-thirds. Every Q3 regression that reached customers would have failed a gate on at least two metrics when replayed.

items.text: **Fix billing retrieval first.** Refresh the policy corpus weekly and require citations in answers.
**Calibrate scores per channel** so a threshold means the same thing everywhere.
sub: Platt scaling against a held-out expert-labelled set
Thresholds signed off by each channel owner

items.text: **Make the gate mandatory** for all LLM releases from January, with a documented override path.

blocks.title: Risk
blocks.text: A miscalibrated gate could block good releases. The override path and monthly threshold review are there to contain that, and we will report false-block rates alongside the gate results.

items: Approve two engineers for Q1 calibration and retrieval work
Endorse mandatory release gating from January
Nominate one owner per channel for rubric sign-off

blocks.text: For the first time we found out about a quality problem before our customers did.
